dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
WORKDIR /testbed

# Configure apt reliability for eval image builds
RUN printf '%s\n' 'Acquire::Retries "5";' 'Acquire::http::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::https::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::http::Pipeline-Depth "0";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99jayint-retries

# Install git for cloning
RUN command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y git)

# Dependency-manager helpers inferred from verified setup
# No extra dependency bootstrap needed

# Clone repository and checkout base commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/unit8co/darts /testbed
# No base commit provided; using repository default branch HEAD

# Agent's verified setup instructions
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install uv' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN cd /testbed && uv sync --group dev-all
RUN export PATH="/testbed/.venv/bin:$PATH"

# Post-setup compatibility helpers inferred from verified setup
# No post-setup compatibility helpers needed
eval_script:
#!/bin/bash

cd /testbed

# Runtime preparation commands verified by the setup agent
set -e
export PATH="/testbed/.venv/bin:$PATH"
set +e

cd /testbed

set +e
(
/testbed/.venv/bin/pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings
)
TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e

echo "echo OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$TEST_EXIT_CODE"
exit $TEST_EXIT_CODE

excluded_commands.command: cat pyproject.toml - read-only inspection, not needed to reproduce the environment
cat Dockerfile - read-only inspection, not needed
which uv pip python3 - failed (uv not installed yet) and was a probe, not a persistent setup step
cd /workspace && uv sync --group dev-all - failed (wrong directory), not part of successful trajectory
pwd && ls -la - read-only inspection, not needed
cd /app && .venv/bin/python -c "import darts..." - read-only verification, not a persistent setup command
python -c "import darts..." (without venv PATH) - failed, not needed
cd /app && .venv/bin/python -c "import darts..." (step 14) - read-only verification, not a setup command

build_recipe.rationale: The agent's successful trajectory shows two persistent state-changing commands: pip install uv (step 5) and cd /app && uv sync --group dev-all (step 8). These installed the uv package manager and then used it to create a virtual environment and install all project dependencies (including dev-all group). This was the minimal setup that allowed the final test (pytest collect-only) to succeed, collecting 10662 tests. The runtime PATH export is needed before test execution but is not a persistent build command, so it is placed in runtime_preparation_commands. Other commands were either read-only, failed, or are test commands and are excluded accordingly.
